scripts.dev: bash scripts/dev-start.sh && concurrently --names "BACK,FRONT" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.prisma:migrate: npm exec -w backend -- prisma migrate dev
scripts.prisma:reset: npm exec -w backend -- prisma migrate reset
